sql: select (select count(*) from incentive_programs) progs, (select count(distinct market_ticker) from incentive_programs where incentive_type ilike '%liquid%') liq_mkts, (select min(first_seen_at) from incentive_programs) first_prog, (select max(last_seen_at) from incentive_programs) last_prog, (select at from incentive_market_snapshots order by id desc limit 1) last_snap, (select at from incentive_market_snapshots order by id asc limit 1) first_snap, (select reltuples::bigint from pg_class where relname='incentive_market_snapshots') snaps, (select received_at from incentive_trade_events order by id desc limit 1) last_trade, (select reltuples::bigint from pg_class where relname='incentive_trade_events') trades, (select started_at from incentive_discovery_cycles order by id desc limit 1) last_disc, (select count(*) from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1') alimm_orders, (select min(created_at) from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1') alimm_first
